name: Kessen! Otome-tachi no Senjou 3 ~Dengeki Sakusen! Senka wa Ace no Na no Moto ni~
original_name: 決戦！乙女たちの戦場3 ～電撃作戦！戦果はエースの名のもとに～
source:
After the end of the second World War, a scientific experiment by the leading post-war nation went terribly wrong, annihilating most of the country. With the world balance suddenly in tatters, countries once again began to fight each other for supremacy. Out of this new war emerged three nations: the Republic of Japan, the Howell Kingdom and the Schwarzwald Empire.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/04/01/april-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
第二次世界大戰結束後，戰後頭號強國進行的一項科學實驗徹底失控，令其大部分國土毀於一旦。世界力量平衡驟然崩潰，各國為爭奪霸權再次開戰。新的戰爭催生出三個國家：日本共和國、霍威爾王國與黑森林帝國。

［引自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/04/01/april-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]］
